title: Link papyrus-home-page.css only on pages that use home-page includes, with its own version token
description:
Repo: **Papyrus**. Bug-shaped chore: once a site sets `homePage`, every page links `css/papyrus-home-page.css`, and because the stylesheet joins the site-wide `?v=` hash, every Anth.us page's `?v=` changed when the newsroom page landed (Anth.us pages were meant to be byte-identical).

## Where it is
- `src/papyrus_content/projection/standard/projector.py`: `HOME_PAGE_CSS_PATH = "css/papyrus-home-page.css"` (line ~95); the file is copied from `assets/papyrus-home-page.css` when `standard.home_page is not None` (~123); it is appended to the stylesheets in `_chrome()` (~1175-1176).
- `?v=`: `MarkusSiteProjector.__init__` -> `static_version(static_files)` (`src/papyrus_content/projection/projector.py` ~152-183) -> `version_token()` (`markus_renderer/pages.py` ~128): one SHA-256 over all top-level `css/*.css` and `assets/**`. The link suffix is built in `markus_renderer/shell.py` ~278; the static-build twin is `markus_renderer/build.py` `_css_version` (~364).

## Change
1. Link the stylesheet only on pages whose rendered body contains a home-page include (`references`, `threads`) or a section-front block. Follow the islands precedent: `_body()` injects the islands script only when the body contains `data-island="` (~1225-1232). Do the same for the CSS: `_chrome()` receives a flag `needs_home_page_css` computed from the page's include records (the include already records which selections a page uses for the digest; reuse that record, do not scan HTML with a regex if the record is available).
2. Give the home-page stylesheet its own version token: `?v=<sha256 of that file, first 12 hex>` instead of the site-wide token, and exclude `css/papyrus-home-page.css` from `static_version`'s input so the site-wide `?v=` of every other page is what it was before the feature. Keep the file itself written to `css/` only when `homePage` is set (unchanged).
3. Same behaviour in `markus_renderer/build.py` for the static build.

## Acceptance
- A fixture site with `homePage` set: a page without includes has the same `?v=` and no home-page `<link>` as the same site without `homePage` (byte-identical HTML). A page with a `references` include has the link with the file's own token.
- Reconcile does not delete `css/papyrus-home-page.css`.
- `procedures/newsroom/tests/test_standard_frontend_*` cover both cases; `npm run lint`/python tests green.

## Gherkin (`features_backend/home-page-stylesheet.feature`)
Feature: The home-page stylesheet is linked only where it is used
  Scenario: A page without home-page includes is byte-identical with and without the homePage setting
  Scenario: A page with a references include links papyrus-home-page.css with its own version token
  Scenario: Changing the home-page stylesheet does not change the version token of other pages

Docs: one line in `docs/home-page.md` ("Stylesheet"). No shared files with the other tasks of this wave except `projector.py` (the Anth.us task touches only the site repo).
